say.text: By evening the first of Zengi's men have reached the landings below the citadel.
I am Usama, of Shaizar. I fought beside the lord of Mosul today. He is behind us on this road, and the Caliph's horsemen are behind him.
Then the river must be ready before he is. Shirkuh: every boat we have, to the three landings. And open the granary.
All of it? There will be questions from Baghdad.
There will. I shall answer them.
Ayyub gave Zengi the boats to cross the Tigris, and showed his followers great kindness and gave them provisions.
Usama ibn Munqidh, the knight of Shaizar who became one of the great writers of his age, later wrote that he was at that battle with Zengi.
Whether Qaraja's riders ever came as far as the river, the histories do not say. Tonight, they do.
